connect.intro: Connect to your operator's service. You need the three things they gave you: the {method}, a {username} and a {password}. No URLs — the app finds the service over the peer-to-peer network.
connect.error.badKey: The panel key should be 64 characters (0–9, a–f) — ask your operator for it.
connect.error.badKeyDesktop: The panel key should be 64 hex characters — ask your operator for it.
connect.error.unreachable: Cannot reach the service — check the details you entered and your connection.
connect.error.malformed: That code is not complete. It has 12 characters, like A3K7-9QF2-M4XR.
connect.error.timeout: No service answered that code. Check the code, and check your connection.
connect.error.unverified: A service answered that code but could not prove it owns it. Ask your operator for the code again.
login.unreachable: Cannot reach the service — check your connection.
settings.smoothZapHint: Preloads nearby channels while you watch, so channel surfing starts instantly. Uses more data; pauses itself on metered connections or when your stream is struggling.
settings.smoothZapHintDesktop: Preloads nearby channels while you watch, so channel surfing starts instantly. Uses more data; pauses itself on constrained connections or when your stream is struggling.
settings.pinNotSet: not set — access-controlled channels are hidden
settings.hideRestrictedHint: Off: access-controlled channels show in the lists and ask for the PIN before playing. On: they disappear from the lists entirely. Changing this asks for the PIN.
settings.removePinHint: Enter the current PIN to remove it. Access-controlled channels go back to being hidden.
settings.hideRestrictedPinHint: Enter the PIN to change the visibility of access-controlled channels.
settings.signOutHint: Sign out forgets the saved sign-in on this device.
settings.changeServiceHint: Forgets this service's panel key and sign-in, then returns to the Connect screen.
settings.changeServiceHintDesktop: Forgets this service's panel key and sign-in, then restarts the app.
settings.update.unsupported: Updates are not available on this build.
settings.update.failed: The check is not possible now. Try again later.
favorites.emptyHint: In Live TV, hold a channel and choose "Add favorite".
pin.label: PIN
pin.setupHint: A 4–8 digit PIN, saved only on this device. Access-controlled channels stay hidden until a PIN exists; with one set, they appear and ask for it before playing.
pin.changeHint: Pick a new 4–8 digit PIN for access-controlled channels.
report.title: REPORT A PROBLEM
report.consent: Sent with your report: the problem you picked, the channel you were watching, your app version and device type, how many peers you were connected to, and the last few things the player did. Your account name and password are never sent.
report.result.cooldown.one: You already reported this. Try again in about {n} minute.
report.result.cooldown.other: You already reported this. Try again in about {n} minutes.
report.result.unsupported: This service doesn't accept problem reports.
report.result.signIn: Please sign in again, then report the problem.
report.result.offline: Not connected to the service right now — try again in a moment.
report.result.failed: Couldn't send the report. Try again in a moment.
vod.sortMenu.title: SORT BY
vod.empty.noProviderHint: This service has no movie provider configured.
vod.empty.noMoviesHint: Movies are not part of this catalog yet.
vod.empty.noSeriesHint: Series are not part of this catalog yet.
vod.empty.myListHint: Titles you add to My List appear here.
vod.empty.noGenresHint: The provider named no genres for these titles.
vod.empty.genreHint: No title here carries that genre.
vod.error.authTitle: Couldn't sign in to the movie catalog
vod.error.authHint: Your account was not accepted by the provider. Contact your service.
vod.error.networkHint: Check your connection and try again in a moment.
vod.error.otherHint: Nothing to show right now — try again later.
vod.series.emptySeason: This season has no episodes yet.
vod.series.notice.noVideo: This episode has no playable video yet. Try another one.
vod.series.notice.noEpisodes: This series has no episodes yet.
vod.player.failedHint: The movie catalog couldn't deliver it right now. Try another title, or come back later.
update.newVersionSized: A new version is available: {version} ({size} MB).
update.metered: You are on a metered network. The download can use much data.
update.permission: Permit this app to install updates. Then press "Install now" again.
hints.favoriteKeyHint: In Live TV, press {key} (or the {star} button) on a channel.
hints.retryEnter: Pick the channel again to retry ({enter} opens the list).
